vulnerability_analysis: The TokenTool contract has an owner-only function multipleBotlistAddress() that can blacklist any address. When an address is blacklisted, it cannot send or receive tokens due to the check in _transfer(). This is an owner privilege abuse vulnerability where the owner can arbitrarily restrict any user's ability to transact.
attack_strategy: Impersonate the contract owner and call multipleBotlistAddress() to blacklist a victim address, then verify the blacklist status.
step_by_step_plan: 1. Get the current owner address from the contract. 2. Impersonate the owner using vm.prank(). 3. Call multipleBotlistAddress() with the victim address and excluded=true. 4. Verify that _isBlacklisted[victim] returns true.
